rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something becoming visible or arising, including a new pattern or structure.

example.english: The gradual emergence of a new cooperation pattern is changing the team.

rows.note: Use this for something coming into view from concealment, especially an image, memory, or outline.

example.english: The sudden emergence of a childhood memory took me back to my old home.

rows.note: Use this more technical term when a pattern or structure arises in a complex system.

example.english: After analyzing the data, we observed the emergence of several new patterns.
